Ext-MS-Win-uiacore-l1-1-0.dll - Ext-MS-Win-UIaCore-l1-1-1.dll - Ext-MS-Win-UIaCore-l1-1-2.dll - Ext-MS-Win-UiaCore-L1-1-3.dll api_name: - UiaGetReservedMixedAttributeValue --- # UiaGetReservedMixedAttributeValue function ## -description Retrieves a reserved value indicating that the value of a Microsoft UI Automation text attribute varies within a text range. ## -parameters ### -param punkMixedAttributeValue [out] Type: IUnknown** Receives a reserved value specifying that an attribute varies over a text range. This parameter is passed uninitialized. ## -returns Type: HRESULT If this function succeeds, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an HRESULT error code. ## -see-also Functions for Providers Text and TextRange Control Patterns
